notes.title: Speed and Gratitude Update
notes.notes:
Speed & Gratitude! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31103305/51ab6f434a5b00de4ea9839e3ed68c4196ac1566.gif

Speed! 

Simulating water physics is a big part of what makes Make Sail unique, and if your boat gets big, it's also a big part of what makes Make Sail slow. 

This update has been a long time in the making but I've finally finished it: A full rewrite of the water physics core logic.  

The new physics are much, much faster. And takes much better advantage of multi-threading.  

You probably won't see much difference for small boats but, for complex boats with several hundred pieces, this update can more than double the frame rate. 



If water physics is what makes your heart sing, you might want to check out this water toy I made to demonstrate this big improvement. 

You can play with it right in your browser

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31103305/d67989c9b96d20b0c00cd6694039ad2eb9b998b4.gif
 
This is a demo of the new tech now powering Make Sail!

Gratitude! 

This update is also celebrating our crowdfunding campaign backers with a musical overture accessible from the title screen and their suggestions in the boat name generator. For the whole story about our glorious book and posters, see here!


Full changelog: 


     Significant CPU usage reduction for complex boats 
     Musical overture 
     1000s of new boat name generator combinations 
     Improved: Better darkness when inside in the storm 
     Fixed: blueprint collection goals may not be visible 
     Fixed: islands and boats named after twitch chat users may have extra "'s" 
     Fixed: some world names were too long to show on the continue button

notes.title: Teaser: The Wind Update!
notes.notes:
Teaser: The Wind Update!

Lest you think I've fallen asleep over here, I will now tease you with thrilling tidbits about the next update in the works: The Wind Update! 

Make Sail's wind has long been over-engineered. Meaning, I wrote way more complex behaviors for it than the game ever used.  

For the last few months, I've been adding features that finally use all that raw vector-math-a-licious power. 

Several big changes are coming, here's a sneak peek: 

For advanced players, there's gonna be so much more than just circular wind. 

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/8b3727ed1160bc1fb63ce809b9e55c15b6cc33f9.gif

And then there's this 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/dc1e701b0b0a7b4d83affe8b0fa048f643934320.gif

I'm shaking the bugs out and sprinkling on fun. While you're waiting, hoot at me in the discord.  


Love, 

Ziba

notes.title: Update 2018.04.06
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103305/f669f1f7c6e65eb6d6acdd0776fec46518d1c166.jpg

It's been one whole grand week drinking from the firehose of Early Access. The feedback (good and bad) has been amazing. Keep it coming, we're listening!

Today's update is about speed and convenience. 


 Performance: Using 17% less RAM
 Performance: Using 14% less GPU RAM
 Performance: Using 28% less disk space
 Fix: Some energy sails could cause the game to panic on boat placement
 Fix: All boat energy could be lost unintentionally
 Improvement: Keep previous sailing camera zoom and height on build exit
 Improvement: Character "run by default" config option
 Improvement: Walking speed config option
 Improvement: Never recenter camera config option
 New: Minimum specification hardware warning screen

notes.title: Update 2018.04.02
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31103305/199d4c87937d83cf80e120b6e129abb611843cf3.jpg

Thanks for all the launch weekend love! So many videos and streams. Make Sail peaked at over 30k simultaneous viewers on Twitch!

We've learned a ton from watching you all play. Today's update is just the start of our work to polish Make Sail until it gleams!

* Feature: MUCH easier to start operating a boat while swimming nearby.
* Feature: Hold instead of tap R to return to building. Prevents accidental taps.
* Feature: Drowning simply warps you back to build.
* Feature: Minor input key ui update.
* Feature: Flashy pink warp effect.
* Fix: Menu visibility error that could happen after drowning.
* Fix: Less sinking after traveling large distances.
* Fix: Error when active propeller leaves view.
